about: One row per Deadlock hero playable as a Risk of Rain 2 survivor. Heights are the hero's body-mesh height in metres as exported from the player's own Deadlock install (VRF glTF, 1 Source unit = 0.0254 m), measured 2026-10-12 on Deadlock ClientVersion 6774. heightScale keeps Deadlock's relative sizes: every hero is scaled by one global factor (anchorHero's height -> Commando's model height), so heightScale = sourceHeight / anchor sourceHeight. passiveName/passiveDescription/passiveIcon: the hero's passive on the character select screen (what the gun already does on hit), or none.

rows.subtitle: The Smoke-Shrouded Assassin
rows.passiveDescription: Every SMG hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Fixation</style> on the target (up to 40, for 6s). Each stack makes that target take <style=cIsDamage>+2.5% damage</style> from Haze.
rows.lore: Deadlock's twin-SMG assassin. Every hit stacks Fixation on her target, Smoke Bomb hides her, Sleep Dagger drops a target and Bullet Dance shreds everything around her.

rows.subtitle: The Unstoppable Detective
rows.lore: Deadlock's brawler detective. He drains life with Siphon Life, crashes through enemies with Shoulder Charge, shrugs off damage with Infernal Resilience and lands from the sky with Seismic Impact.

rows.subtitle: The Living Storm
rows.lore: Deadlock's lightning caster. He throws Lightning Balls, plants Static Charges that stun, chains Power Surge through crowds and rises into a Storm Cloud.

rows.subtitle: The Burning Man
rows.passiveDescription: Gun hits build <style=cIsDamage>Afterburn</style>. At 12 stacks the target <style=cIsDamage>burns</style> for 100% damage per second for 3s.
rows.lore: Deadlock's arsonist. His bullets build Afterburn, Catalyst makes victims burn hotter, Flame Dash leaves fire behind him and Concussive Combustion levels the room.
